# CGRX v0.1.0-alpha.15

This alpha makes the local graph explorer responsive on larger repositories while keeping relationship evidence and coverage gaps explicit.

- Opens and refreshes projects outside HTTP handlers with bounded worker queues, four open runtimes and a 128 MiB response cache.
- Adds compact snapshot-bound topology for up to 20,000 symbols and 120,000 relationships, with lazy retrieval of proven edge evidence.
- Renders 2D with Sigma and 3D with batched/instanced Three.js geometry. Community depth remains a presentation choice, not an inferred dependency or confidence score.
- Retains selection and camera across refreshes, cancels obsolete layout/similarity work, and falls back to a clearly capped SVG view after WebGL loss.
- Adds browser, backend and reproducible performance fixtures. See [alpha.15 performance and release evidence](https://github.com/ibotpafos/cgrx/blob/v0.1.0-alpha.15/docs/alpha15-performance.md).

The Apple Silicon archive includes bundled web assets and `SHA256SUMS`. Linux and Intel macOS remain pinned source-install paths with Rust 1.89.0.
